#data
```{r}
bin16_list_ann <- readRDS("~/data/bin16_list_ann.rds")
sham_list <- bin16_list_ann[names(bin16_list_ann) %in% c("sham_b1","sham_b3","sham_b6")]
c26_list <- bin16_list_ann[names(bin16_list_ann) %in% c("c26_b2","c26_b4","c26_b6")]

for (nm in names(sham_list)) {
    spe <- sham_list[[nm]]
    colData(spe)$sample_id <- rep(nm, ncol(spe))
    sham_list[[nm]] <- spe
}

for (nm in names(c26_list)) {
    spe <- c26_list[[nm]]
    colData(spe)$sample_id <- rep(nm, ncol(spe))
    c26_list[[nm]] <- spe
}

combined_sham <- do.call(cbind, sham_list)
combined_c26 <- do.call(cbind, c26_list)
combined_sham <- combined_sham[,!is.na(combined_sham$new_cell_type)]
combined_c26 <- combined_c26[,!is.na(combined_c26$new_cell_type)]

#myo aggregated ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
myo <- c("Myonuclei_IIb","Myonuclei_IIx","Myonuclei_IIx_IIa","Myonuclei_IIx_IIb",
         "Myonuclei_MTJ","Myonuclei_NMJ","Myonuclei_Trim63")
combined_sham$agg_myo_types <- as.factor(ifelse(combined_sham$new_cell_type %in% myo,
                                      "myo", combined_sham$new_cell_type))
combined_c26$agg_myo_types <- as.factor(ifelse(combined_c26$new_cell_type %in% myo,
                                      "myo", combined_c26$new_cell_type))

#only myo ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
myo_sham <- combined_sham[,combined_sham$new_cell_type %in% myo]
myo_sham$new_cell_type <- as.factor(myo_sham$new_cell_type)
myo_c26 <- combined_c26[,combined_c26$new_cell_type %in% myo]
myo_c26$new_cell_type <- as.factor(myo_c26$new_cell_type)
```

#Function for dotplot
```{r}
plot_sc_dotplot <- function(sc_object, gene_vector, celltype_col = "celltype", 
                            save_path = NULL, width = 8, height = 5) {
  
  # 1. Extract cell types as a clean character vector
  if (!celltype_col %in% colnames(colData(sc_object))) {
    stop(paste("Column", celltype_col, "not found in colData(sc_object)"))
  }
  celltypes <- as.character(colData(sc_object)[[celltype_col]])
  unique_cts <- unique(celltypes)
  
  # 2. Filter for valid genes
  genes_to_use <- gene_vector[gene_vector %in% rownames(sc_object)]
  if(length(genes_to_use) == 0) {
    stop("None of the provided genes were found in the sc_object.")
  }
  
  # 3. Extract sparse matrix ONLY for genes of interest
  expr_mat <- assay(sc_object, "logcounts")[genes_to_use, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # 4. Compute average expression per cell type
  # Using do.call(cbind, lapply(...)) guarantees a 2D matrix even for 1 gene
  std_prof <- do.call(cbind, lapply(unique_cts, function(ct) {
    Matrix::rowMeans(expr_mat[, celltypes == ct, drop = FALSE])
  }))
  rownames(std_prof) <- genes_to_use
  colnames(std_prof) <- unique_cts  # Explicitly assign cell type column names
  
  # 5. Compute % expressing cells
  pct_expr <- do.call(cbind, lapply(unique_cts, function(ct) {
    subset_mat <- expr_mat[, celltypes == ct, drop = FALSE]
    Matrix::rowMeans(subset_mat > 0)
  }))
  rownames(pct_expr) <- genes_to_use
  colnames(pct_expr) <- unique_cts  # Explicitly assign cell type column names
  
  # 6. Convert to data.frame safely (check.names = FALSE preserves spaces/dashes)
  std_prof_df <- as.data.frame(std_prof, check.names = FALSE)
  std_prof_df$gene <- rownames(std_prof_df)
  
  pct_expr_df <- as.data.frame(pct_expr, check.names = FALSE)
  pct_expr_df$gene <- rownames(pct_expr_df)
  
  # 7. Reshape to Long format
  expr_long <- std_prof_df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -gene, names_to = "celltype", values_to = "expression")
  
  pct_long <- pct_expr_df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -gene, names_to = "celltype", values_to = "percent")
  
  # 8. Merge expression + percent and filter
  expr_long <- expr_long %>%
    left_join(pct_long, by = c("gene", "celltype")) %>%
    filter(expression > 0)
  
  # 9. Generate the plot
  p <- ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = gene, y = celltype)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = percent, color = expression)) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "red", name = "Mean\nExpression") +
    scale_size(range = c(1, 6), name = "% Expressing", labels = scales::percent_format()) + 
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(x = "Gene", y = "Cell Type")
  
  # 10. Save if path is provided
  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(filename = save_path, plot = p, width = width, height = height, bg = "white")
    message("Plot saved to: ", save_path)
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```

#Applying the function
```{r}
# my_plot <- plot_sc_dotplot(combined_sham, genes_axone_guidance, celltype_col = "new_cell_type",
#                            save_path = "sham_dotplot.png")
# my_plot <- plot_sc_dotplot(combined_c26, genes_axone_guidance, celltype_col = "new_cell_type",
#                            save_path = "c26_dotplot.png")

myo_sham_sema <- plot_sc_dotplot(myo_sham, sema_genes, celltype_col = "new_cell_type",
                           save_path = "myo_sham_sema_dotplot.png")
myo_c26_sema <- plot_sc_dotplot(myo_c26, sema_genes, celltype_col = "new_cell_type",
                           save_path = "myo_c26_sema_dotplot.png")
myo_sham_receptors <- plot_sc_dotplot(myo_sham, receptors_genes, celltype_col = "new_cell_type",
                           save_path = "myo_sham_receptors_dotplot.png")
myo_c26_receptors <- plot_sc_dotplot(myo_c26, receptors_genes, celltype_col = "new_cell_type",
                           save_path = "myo_c26_receptors_dotplot.png")
myo_sham_others <- plot_sc_dotplot(myo_sham, other_genes, celltype_col = "new_cell_type",
                           save_path = "myo_sham_others_dotplot.png")
myo_c26_others <- plot_sc_dotplot(myo_c26, other_genes, celltype_col = "new_cell_type",
                           save_path = "myo_c26_others_dotplot.png")

interstitial_sham_sema <- plot_sc_dotplot(combined_sham, sema_genes, celltype_col = "agg_myo_types",
                           save_path = "interstitial_sham_sema_dotplot.png")
interstitial_c26_sema <- plot_sc_dotplot(combined_c26, sema_genes, celltype_col = "agg_myo_types",
                           save_path = "interstitial_c26_sema_dotplot.png")
interstitial_sham_receptors <- plot_sc_dotplot(combined_sham, receptors_genes, celltype_col = "agg_myo_types",
                           save_path = "interstitial_sham_receptors_dotplot.png")
interstitial_c26_receptors <- plot_sc_dotplot(combined_c26, receptors_genes, celltype_col = "agg_myo_types",
                           save_path = "interstitial_c26_receptors_dotplot.png")
interstitial_sham_others <- plot_sc_dotplot(combined_sham, other_genes, celltype_col = "agg_myo_types",
                           save_path = "interstitial_sham_others_dotplot.png")
interstitial_c26_others <- plot_sc_dotplot(combined_c26, other_genes, celltype_col = "agg_myo_types",
                           save_path = "interstitial_c26_others_dotplot.png")

```
